libchrome: Add base::Optional. base::Optional (which works like std::optional from C++17) is pretty useful to wrap syscall return values where the syscall might return a valid positive integer (like a PID) on success, but -1 on error (like fork(2)). ToT libchrome already has base::Optional, but 395517 does not. If we ever uprev this patch can be dropped. nocturne: Use USBC alert signal for TCPC alert status Because the TCPC and PPC share a common interrupt signal, the TCPC alert register must be read to know when to process alerts for the TCPC. However, the interrupt signal can be used to know which port to check and prevent interrupts from one port causing the TCPC on another port from being pulled out of low power mode unecessarily. This CL adds a check of the USBC interrupt line level to know which TCPC to check. BUG=b:112039224 BRANCH=nocturne TEST=Verifed that connecting to 1 of the ports no longer causes the other port to exit/enter low power mode. Change-Id: I70384a1fc8f1cc03ad81e694a4246e0cb284375f Signed-off-by: Scott Collyer <scollyer@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1196044 Commit-Ready: Scott Collyer <scollyer@chromium.org> Tested-by: Scott Collyer <scollyer@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Aseda Aboagye <aaboagye@chromium.org>

sys-devel/arc-llvm: Only install one copy of libLLVM arc-llvm installs a copy of libLLVM.so into the build directory. The copy of the lib in build/ is the one that is used at build time by other packages that link against arc-llvm (ie arc-mesa). However, build_image only includes the contents of the vendor partition in the final image, and thus we currently also make a copy into vendor/ for use at runtime. Having two copies, however dramatically increases the size of the build, however, since each 26 MB .so has its own 1 GB .debug file, so instead replace the build/ copy with a symlink to the vendor/ copy. Doing so ensures that the .debug corresponds to the version actually installed in the image.
